rules_library.name: ranks_five_to_nine

rules_library.name: opposite_parity

rules_library.name: rank_non_decreasing_start_ace
rules_library.description: Each card must have a rank greater or equal to the previous card. Only Ace can start the line.

rules_library.name: alternating_colors
rules_library.description: Cards must alternate between red and black colors. Any card may start the line.

rules_library.name: different_suit
rules_library.description: The card must be of a different suit than the card just before it. Any card may start the line.

rules_library.name: cyclic_suit_order
rules_library.description: Suits must repeat in the cyclic order hearts → spades → clubs → diamonds → hearts... Any card may start the line.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
order = ["hearts", "spades", "clubs", "diamonds"]
prev_suit = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
prev_idx = order.index(prev_suit)
expected = order[(prev_idx + 1) % 4]
return card.suit.suit_name == expected

rules_library.name: alternating_groups
rules_library.description: Hearts and spades form Group A; clubs and diamonds form Group B. Alternate between groups. Any card may start the line.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1].suit.suit_name
curr = card.suit.suit_name
group_a = {"hearts", "spades"}
# Determine groups: True for group A, False for group B
prev_group = prev in group_a
curr_group = curr in group_a
return curr_group != prev_group

rules_library.name: share_color_or_parity
rules_library.description: Each card must share at least one property with the previous card: same color, or same parity. Any card may start the line.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return True
prev = mainline[-1]
same_color = card.color == prev.color
same_parity = (card.rank % 2) == (prev.rank % 2)
return same_color or same_parity

rules_library.name: red_up_black_down
rules_library.description: If the previous card was red, rank must increase or be equal; if black, rank must decrease or be equal. Starting card must be between 5 and 9 inclusive.
rules_library.code:
if not mainline:
    return 5 <= card.rank <= 9
prev = mainline[-1]
if prev.color == "red":
    return card.rank >= prev.rank
else:  # black
    return card.rank <= prev.rank

rules_library.name: face_card_imposes_suit
rules_library.description: Face cards imposes the suit: if a face card is played, the next card must match its suit. Otherwise, the next card must be a different suit than it.
